why: A (universes at 0) gives the six conditions of Definition 7.3 for (X, 𝐗^R), effectivity of reducedEpGroupoid and proposition_7_10_2017, all (except exists_isProperMap_reduced) under the hypotheses [T2Space X.ReducedMor] [ParacompactSpace X.ReducedMor] (satisfiable, e.g. for effective X). B asserts for every ep-groupoid that 𝐗^R is Hausdorff and paracompact and carries an effective ep-groupoid structure with the reduced data and reducedPolyfold. B ⇒ A reads every conjunct off B's Y (isotropy and functor conjuncts of proposition_7_10_2017 from the project's quotientTrivialSubgroupEquiv and reductionFunctor); with Hausdorff+paracompact 𝐗^R as an added hypothesis A ⇒ B holds (A_to_B_of_hyp), so the hypotheses are the only difference. But B does not hold as we read the text (not_B, hence not_A_to_B): for ℤ/2 ⋉ O, O the dimension-jumping sc-retract of Remark 4.3 (Part I's RemarkFourThree.fam: O = {(t,0)} for t ≤ 0, a line over t > 0) with (t,z) ↦ (t,±z), (−1,(t,0)) ∈ 𝐗^T for t < 0 but (−1,0) ∉ 𝐗^T, so [(±1, (−1/(n+1),0))] converges to both [(−1,0)] ≠ [(1,0)] and 𝐗^R is not Hausdorff.
